title: NemoWorld unified asset library - selected family manifest
integration_status: SELECTION AND RIGHTS RECORD ONLY. Nothing in this manifest was downloaded, extracted, converted, imported or integrated, and no browser check was performed by this task.

method.basis: This manifest does not start new research. It reads the verified 25-candidate survey in docs/research/ASSET_SHORTLIST.md and docs/research/ASSET_SHORTLIST.json (checked 2026-10-12) and makes the selection decision that survey left open.
method.licence_rule: An engine or repository licence does not licence its bundled assets. A licence counts as verified only when the rights holder's own document or page was read; where that could not be done, the right is recorded as unresolved rather than assumed.
method.measurement_rule: Every polycount in this manifest is measured from the real builder by importing src/voxel-world.js and reading createVoxelScene().update().stats, not estimated from a screenshot or a publisher claim. Where no measurement exists the field says so.
method.excluded_by_instruction: No proprietary or decompiled Minecraft content, no Minecraft-replica project, and no Sword Art Online character, texture, logo, name or code is recorded, selected or referenced anywhere in this library.

field_notes.status: produced = the artifact exists in this repository and is drawn today. vendored-third-party = a third-party file already in this repository whose licence was read at the rights holder's own file. specified-not-produced = specified by this library; no geometry, file or licence exists yet. blocked = a candidate whose licence was verified but which is not selected.
field_notes.source_url: The rights holder's own page for a third-party entry. null for project-authored entries, which have no upstream URL; use source_path and source_detail instead.
field_notes.source_path: The repository file a project-authored entry lives in, or the vendored directory for a third-party entry.
field_notes.package_or_version: The exact pack name and version/commit for third-party entries; the family spec version and the repository for project work.
field_notes.license: The licence record. spdx is the identifier distributed with the entry; notice_file and notice_sha256 are the notice file the sealed content layer references; verified_from_publisher_file says whether a rights holder document was actually read.
field_notes.attribution_notice: The credit or notice a distribution must carry. "No third-party credit is required" is not a statement that provenance should be unrecorded.
field_notes.modification_permission: Whether modification is permitted and on what basis. "unverified" means no licence text exists to rely on.
field_notes.format: Only what is actually true: procedural box geometry for project work, or the publisher-stated formats for a third-party candidate whose archive was never opened.
field_notes.dimensions_or_polycount: Measured boxes and triangles from the real builder for produced entries; "not published / not measured" for packs that were never downloaded. Nothing here is an estimate.
field_notes.download_size: Bytes already present in the repository for a vendored entry, or measured HTTP HEAD values recorded by the research for unselected candidates, or "not applicable" for in-repo code.
field_notes.scale: Expressed in the project's own units: 1 tile = 1 virtual metre, blocks 1x1x1 on layers z 0-7. rendered_height_m is the measured or specified height; block_layers_occupied is ceil(rendered_height_m) starting at 0.
field_notes.orientation: Every family item is axis-aligned with rotation 0 degrees and is never mirrored. world X = tile x, world Z = tile y, world Y = block layer z; forward_axis names the face a door or window sits on.
field_notes.collision_footprint: The occupancy the server enforces and the renderer draws, from the single shared table in src/footprints.js: mass occupies its tile and is not walkable, flat is knee-height and walkable, frame is an open walk-through marker. An unrecognised type fails closed as a mass.
field_notes.intended_use: What the entry is for in the game, in one sentence, so an implementer knows where it belongs before placing it.
field_notes.unresolved_rights: Everything still unconfirmed for that entry. A right is recorded as unresolved rather than assumed, and an entry with no asset-level licence is marked do-not-integrate in the top-level register.

family.name: NemoWorld Commons set
family.decision: One coherent family: original project-authored, flat-shaded cube geometry, plus the two third-party art sets already vendored in this repository that the existing code paths can already address (the CC0 mayor sprite sheets and the ISC Lucide icon set). No third-party 3D mesh pack is selected, and nothing is downloaded, imported or integrated by this task.
why_this_and_not_a_licensed_mesh_pack: The pinned renderer has no model loader. Importing assets/vendor/three-voxel.js exposes exactly 27 symbols (ACESFilmicToneMapping, BoxGeometry, CanvasTexture, Color, DirectionalLight, EdgesGeometry, Fog, Group, HemisphereLight, InstancedMesh, LineBasicMaterial, LineSegments, Matrix4, Mesh, MeshBasicMaterial, MeshLambertMaterial, Object3D, PCFShadowMap, PerspectiveCamera, Raycaster, SRGBColorSpace, Scene, Sprite, SpriteMaterial, Vector2, Vector3, WebGLRenderer) with no GLTFLoader, no OBJLoader and no TextureLoader. Measured 2026-10-13; the file is 551,333 bytes with SHA-256 37fe9184bb0c982e1d48e77375fbeb6b2f8a3fdd54b62a5f0cd87499fdcb5e88, the same values assets/vendor/three-source-manifest.json records.

No licensed pack is a drop-in. Every 3D candidate in docs/research/ASSET_SHORTLIST.json records integration_cost "High" for the same missing-loader reason, and none is grid-aligned: Kenney Nature Kit (CC0, 10.05 MiB, 330 organic low-poly models), Kenney City Kit Suburban (CC0, 2.90 MiB, modern suburban vocabulary), Kenney Furniture Kit (CC0, 4.89 MiB), KayKit Adventurers (CC0, rigged humanoids with skeletal animation) and KayKit Medieval Hexagon (hex tiles on a square grid).

Re-bundling the renderer was already rejected. docs/VOXEL_WORLD.md records the bundle as pinned and hash-verified; docs/research/ASSET_SHORTLIST.md "What a selection would still require" states that adding a loader means re-bundling and re-hashing, which the engine decision record (docs/VOXEL_ENGINE_REUSE.md) rejected for meshing. That is an engineering decision, and no asset download settles it.

Per-file terms inside every pack archive are still unread. docs/research/ASSET_SHORTLIST.json unresolved_rights_register says the licence was read from the publisher's own repository file or asset page, but the License.txt inside each archive was not inspected, because that would require a download this task forbids. No pack can be called fully verified today.

The content layer already answers the same question this way. content/THIRD_PARTY.md records every block, furniture, crop and cosmetic definition as LicenseRef-NemoWorld-Project-Authored with appearance.geometry "cube" or a builder name in src/voxel-world.js, and the 20 appearances as the only third-party art. This library extends that answer rather than contradicting it.

The two vendored sets work through paths that exist now. Lucide SVGs are served as files and used through plus a CSS filter (server.js:71, app.js:507, nemo-theme.css:11); the CC0 mayor sheets load through the 2D canvas atlas route and are sealed as content/appearances/*.json. Neither needs a new loader, a CSP change or a new dependency.

palette_tokens.note: The tokens are the colours the family is actually drawn in: the renderer tints in src/voxel-world.js LOCAL_COLORS and its per-builder literals, the sealed block colours in content/blocks/*.json, the seven agent colours and eight calling colours in content/cosmetics/, and the interface tokens from nemo-theme.css (--gold #ded6a5, --ink #f1f0df, --bg #051d18, --panel #12382e). This library introduces no new colour. The two representative tokens stand for a set, not one colour: commons.agent.representative is the first of seven sealed agent colours, calling.representative the first of eight calling colours, commons.blossom one of three flower heads, commons.skin one of four tones.

grid_contract.tile: 1 tile = 1 virtual metre. The shared frontier is 16 x 16 areas of 48 x 48 virtual metres, in 8 x 8 parcels of 6 x 6 (docs/VOXEL_WORLD.md, docs/LAND_WORLD.md).
grid_contract.block: Blocks are 1 x 1 x 1 m cubes on integer layers z 0 to 7 (content/README.md stack.z_min/z_max; VOXEL_LIMITS.height = 8).
grid_contract.world_axis_map: world X = tile x, world Z = tile y, world Y = block layer z (src/voxel-world.js cubeBatch). A pick keeps horizontal x/y and vertical z.

footprint_classes.mass: occupies its tile at resident height; not walkable; roofs and canopies rise above 1.52 m
footprint_classes.flat: ground detail at or below 0.5 m inside its own tile; walkable
footprint_classes.frame: open marker; geometry in the tile-edge bands with cross members above 1.52 m; walkable
footprint_classes.note: An unrecognised scenery type fails closed as a mass (src/footprints.js DEFAULT_SCENERY_CLASS).

per_item_boxes.note: Measured over the real builder: furn.cushion and furn.path-object are 1 box; furn.bookshelf is 13. arch.civic-hall, arch.canopy-arch, veg.hedge-row and ui.asset-library-glyph are specified and have no measurement.

measured_window_boxes.note: A uniform 37 x 37 window (1,369 cells) measured with createVoxelScene().update() on 2026-10-13; the worst measured case is 8,230 boxes = 98,760 triangles.

geometry_budget.batching: One InstancedMesh per colour and material style (src/voxel-world.js cubeBatch), so the budget is boxes, not draw calls; triangles are 12 per box.
